'''Gossam Courivers''' were a [[Pre-Republic era|Pre-Republic]] organization of [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] explorers who made use of the early [[Tumbledrive/Legends|tumbledrive]]. In [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]] they colonized [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].
